title: Kubeconfig file
description: The kubeconfig file, also used by kubectl, contains details about Kubernetes clusters including their location and credentials. If the cluster is hosted as a cloud service (such as AKS or GKE), this file is downloaded to the client via cloud commands (e.g., `az aks get-credential` for AKS or `gcloud container clusters get-credentials` for GKE).   If attackers get access to this file, for instance via a compromised client, they can use it for accessing the clusters.
